cities.route: I-80 West: New Jersey > Pennsylvania mountains > Ohio > south of Chicago > Iowa > Nebraska > Wyoming > Salt Lake City
cities.profile_old: The densest start in the game (about 29,300 people per square mile), so the outbreak is worst here on Day 1. The player has to escape the most infected city fast, about 280 miles a day. Food and water are easy to find in the first two days and scarce on the plains, so stocking up early matters. Wyoming's deep cold slows the infected but punishes anyone without shelter.
cities.profile: The densest start in the game (New York County: about 70,503 people per square mile, 2023 Census), so the outbreak is worst here on Day 1. The player has to escape the most infected city fast, about 280 miles a day. Food and water are easy to find in the first two days and scarce on the plains, so stocking up early matters. Wyoming's deep cold slows the infected but punishes anyone without shelter.

scenes.title: Bridges Close at Noon
scenes.text: An emergency alert screams from every phone: all bridges and tunnels out of Manhattan close at NOON. It's 8 a.m. Your neighbor's door bursts open down the hall, and someone is screaming.

options.text: Raid the corner store for water and snacks, then run for the bridge
options.why: The supplies help a lot later, but the store is chaos and the player barely beats the closure.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Push into Penn Station for the last train west
options.why: Trains might run, but packed stations are the worst place in the highest-infection city in the game.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Drive your car toward the Holland Tunnel
options.why: Looks fastest, but tunnels jam solid with no side exits, and the infected move between stalled cars.

options.text: Grab your go-bag and walk fast to the George Washington Bridge
options.why: Walking beats gridlock, and the GW Bridge leads straight to I-80 West. The player makes it out with hours to spare.

scenes.title: Fort Lee, 24°F
scenes.text: You crossed into New Jersey. It's dark by 4:45 p.m. and 24°F. An empty diner, an SUV idling with its door wide open, and people waving from an apartment lobby.
scenes.place: between New York City, NY (Manhattan) and Pocono Mountains, PA

options.text: Join the people waving from the lobby
options.why: Warm and friendly, but strangers are unpredictable. A tense but safe night.
changes: now also sets NJ_CONTACTS: The lobby group writes your name on their survivor list and radios it ahead to the western safe zones.

options.text: Break into the diner, barricade the doors, and eat
options.why: A gas stove for heat, a walk-in fridge of food, and bottled drinks. One door to watch.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Jump in the idling SUV and go
options.why: Looks like a jackpot, but the owner turned in the back seat. An attack from behind.

options.text: Keep walking in the dark toward I-80
options.why: Miles gained, but ice and darkness mean falls and surprise attacks.

scenes.title: The Wall of Cars
scenes.text: I-80 through the Pocono Mountains is a frozen wall of abandoned cars. Snow is falling hard. A tow truck sits with its keys in it, and a car dealership's showroom glows nearby.

options.text: Follow fresh tire tracks leading off the highway
options.why: Looks smart (someone made it through!), but the tracks lead to a raider camp.

options.text: Take the tow truck
options.why: Looks slow and loud, but it can shove stalled cars aside and plow through snowdrifts. The perfect jam-buster.

options.text: Grab a new car from the dealership showroom
options.why: Looks like the obvious move, but dozens of people sheltered there and turned.

options.text: Ride a bike from a shop along the shoulder
options.why: It gets past the jam, but biking in a snowstorm is brutal and the player carries little.

scenes.title: The Hunting Cabin
scenes.text: Snow Shoe, Pennsylvania. A truck stop roars with a generator and bright lights. Up a dark trail, smoke rises from a hunting cabin's chimney.
scenes.place: between Pocono Mountains, PA and Toledo, OH

options.text: Hike to the hunting cabin
options.why: An old hunter shares venison jerky and melts snow on his wood stove for drinking water. Quiet and safe.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 0.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower
now also sets HUNTER_MAP: The cabin owner draws you a map of Wyoming ranch roads and private fuel tanks.

options.text: Sleep in the sporting goods store downtown
options.why: Good gear, but the broken windows mean a freezing night.

options.text: Head for the truck stop with power
options.why: Electricity seems great, but the noise and light pull in every infected for miles.

options.text: Keep driving the mountain grades through the night
options.why: Gains miles, but black ice on the grades causes crashes.

scenes.title: The Boy at the Rest Stop
scenes.text: At an Ohio rest stop, a boy about ten runs toward you, crying. His dad is "sick" and won't wake up in their fogged-up car. Something inside the car bangs against the window.

options.text: Pull the boy away and leave the car shut
options.why: The dad has turned. The boy isn't bitten, and he becomes a loyal companion. Sets BOY_ALLY.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Open the car door to check on his dad
options.why: The dad lunges out. The worst outcome.

options.text: Drive away without stopping
options.why: Safe from the dad, but the story and the player's morale take a hit.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Give the boy food and directions to the next town, then leave
options.why: Safe for the player, but they lose a potential ally and some food.

scenes.title: Lake-Effect Whiteout
scenes.text: Near Toledo, lake-effect snow off Lake Erie turns everything white. A hospital with a red cross banner glows to your left. A big-box store with a roof ladder sits to your right.
scenes.place: between Toledo, OH and Joliet area, IL

options.text: Shelter in a lakeside boathouse
options.why: Quiet, but freezing wind off the lake all night.

options.text: Seek help at the hospital
options.why: A red cross looks safe, but hospitals were ground zero. Overrun.

options.text: Drive through the whiteout
options.why: Zero visibility. Maybe the player makes it, maybe they end up in a ditch.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Climb the ladder to the big-box store roof and drop in through the hatch
options.why: Zombies can't climb ladders. Inside: shelves of canned food and cases of water.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 35, water 35): you can only carry so much
time 0.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

conditional.text: Drive the whiteout in a snowplow's fresh tracks
conditional.effects_text: saves 3 h of driving; injury risk 40%
conditional.why: Fast, but one slide off the tracks and you're in a ditch.

scenes.title: The Convoy
scenes.text: South of Chicago, National Guard trucks race west, sirens blaring. A soldier leans out: "Get in! Secure camp in Chicago!" Behind the convoy, a crowd of infected is chasing the noise.

options.text: Follow the convoy at a distance
options.why: The player might pick up dropped supplies, or drive into the crowd chasing the trucks.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Jump in and ride the convoy into Chicago
options.why: Soldiers look like safety, but the camp is in a city of 2.7 million and already falling.

options.text: Wave them on, then ask the last truck for fuel and water
options.why: Soldiers toss the player water bottles and a road report showing which roads west are clear.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Hide in a ditch until the convoy and the crowd pass
options.why: No reward, but no risk either.

scenes.title: The Jackknifed Semi
scenes.text: A jackknifed grocery semi blocks the bridge over the Illinois River. The ice on the river below looks solid, but you can hear water moving under it. Something shuffles inside the trailer.
scenes.place: between Joliet area, IL and Davenport / Quad Cities, IA

options.text: Drive across the frozen river
options.why: Moving rivers rarely freeze solid. The ice gives way.

options.text: Backtrack 20 miles to the next bridge
options.why: Safe, but it costs fuel and hours.

options.text: Find the keys in the cab and move the semi
options.why: The keys are in the cab, the shuffling is a loose pallet, and the trailer is full of food.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 15): you can only carry so much

options.text: Climb over the semi on foot with your gear
options.why: The player gets across, but tears their arm on jagged metal. Sets SCRATCHED.

scenes.title: The Bite Check
scenes.text: At the Mississippi River bridge into Iowa, soldiers with rifles are screening everyone for bites. Your travel partner has a fresh scratch they swear came from a fence. The line is moving fast.

options.text: Look for another crossing upriver
options.why: Safe, but it costs half a day.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 12.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +10 health from rest

options.text: Hide the scratch under a coat
options.why: Seems clever, but soldiers search everyone. Getting caught means being detained at gunpoint.

options.text: Leave your partner behind and cross alone
options.why: The player crosses safely but loses an ally. A heavy choice.

options.text: Be honest and show the scratch
options.why: A medic confirms it's from a fence. Honesty gets the player through, and they get a medical check and water.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

conditional.text: Tell the soldiers you've been bitten and ask for their medic
conditional.effects_text: 6 h; treatment 90% (fictional); turned away from the bridge until cleared
conditional.why: Honesty gets you treatment before the point of no return.

scenes.title: The Farmhouse Dinner
scenes.text: In Iowa, an elderly couple invites you in for hot stew. They seem kind. A shotgun leans by their door, and you hear something moving in the barn.
scenes.place: between Davenport / Quad Cities, IA and North Platte, NE

options.text: Steal their truck while they sleep
options.why: Their son is on guard in the barn. Shots fired.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Thank them and sleep in your car
options.why: Safe and polite, but cold and hungry.

options.text: Accept, but keep watch in shifts
options.why: Kindness plus caution. A hot meal, filled water jugs and a safe night. The barn noise is their cow.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Accept and sleep soundly
options.why: Probably fine, but no one is on watch if something goes wrong.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

scenes.title: Bailey Yard
scenes.text: North Platte, Nebraska: the world's largest rail yard. A rail worker has a locomotive running and says he can take it 200 miles west. Infected are pouring out of the yard office toward you.

options.text: Climb aboard the locomotive with him now
options.why: Sounds crazy, but tracks aren't jammed like highways. Over 200 fast miles, and he shares his lunch.

options.text: Try to drive another locomotive yourself
options.why: The player has no idea how. Derailment.

options.text: Stay on I-80 and drive away
options.why: Safe and steady, but the player misses the shortcut.

options.text: Grab food from the yard cafeteria first
options.why: Food inside, but the infected are coming from that direction.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

conditional.text: Trade food for gasoline from the rail yard's drums
conditional.why: The rail worker needs food more than gas.

scenes.title: The Air Force Base
scenes.text: In Cheyenne, the air base gates hang open. The wind howls at 60 mph. A helicopter sits on the pad, and a fuel depot and mess hall are lit by emergency lights.
scenes.place: between North Platte, NE and Rock Springs, WY

options.text: Take the helicopter
options.why: Exciting, but the player can't fly, and nobody flies in 60 mph winds.

options.text: Search the armory
options.why: Weapons help, but it's been picked over.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Sleep in the barracks
options.why: Warm beds, but the soldiers sheltered there may have turned.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Fill up at the fuel depot and raid the mess hall
options.why: A full tank, military rations and jugs of water for the empty stretch ahead.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: Frozen Solid
scenes.text: It's -15°F near Rock Springs, Wyoming. The infected along I-80 are frozen stiff and barely moving. Your gas is low, and the only station is in the middle of town.
scenes.weather_note: -15°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 21.5°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Stop to destroy the frozen infected one by one
options.why: It works, but the player is exposed to frostbite for an hour.

options.text: Drive into town now while they're sluggish and fill up
options.why: The cold rule from our infection model: extreme cold slows the infected way down. Use it.

options.text: Coast to the next town on fumes
options.why: Probably okay, but the player arrives with an empty tank.

options.text: Build a campfire next to the frozen ones to warm up
options.why: They look dead, but the fire thaws them out.

unlocked.text: Follow the hunter's map to a ranch's private fuel tank
unlocked.why: The map is right: a farm tank miles from the frozen crowd in town.

scenes.title: The Final Gate
scenes.text: You reach the Salt Lake City safe zone at night. Guards order everyone to strip off their coats for a bite check in the freezing wind. A stranger beside you refuses and starts shouting.
scenes.place: Salt Lake City safe zone, UT
scenes.gate_check: Every final gate now runs a screening check before admission. Not infected: admitted. Infected but not turned: quarantine with treatment (90%, fictional). The clock still matters: if a time penalty pushes arrival past Day 7 midnight, the ending is TOO LATE. No single choice at the gate ends the game by itself anymore.

options.text: Try to keep a hidden knife
options.effects_text: found: held 6 h for questioning; no injury
options.why: The guards find it, take it, and make you wait. Costly, not fatal.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Wait outside until morning when things calm down
options.effects_text: 10 h in the cold; -10 health; still enter if before the deadline
options.why: Calmer in daylight, but a long freezing night.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Cooperate fully and step away from the stranger
options.effects_text: 1 h; screened and admitted
options.why: Fast, safe, and honest.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Demand the guards let the stranger in without a check
options.effects_text: held overnight: 12 h; -10 health
options.why: Looks brave, but it marks you as a risk. You're held until morning.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

unlocked.text: Give the guards your name from the Fort Lee survivor list
unlocked.effects_text: 0.5 h; skips the line; still screened
unlocked.why: They have the list. You're moved to the front of screening and out of the wind.

scenes.title: The Chase
scenes.text: Your bad call drew a pack of infected, and now you're on foot, sprinting through snowy suburban backyards. They're 30 feet behind you and closing.

options.text: Climb trash cans onto a garage roof and kick the cans away
options.why: The infected can't climb. The player waits on the roof until the pack drifts off, then sneaks back.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Dive into the thick bushes and hold perfectly still
options.why: Looks like a smart hiding spot, but winter bushes have no leaves. The infected see the player right through the bare branches.

options.text: Jump the backyard fences one after another
options.why: Fences slow the infected, but the player snags their arm on chain-link going over the third one. Sets the SCRATCHED flag, and the Aching Arm callback plays 2 scenarios later.

options.text: Circle back to your vehicle the long way around the block
options.why: It works, but it takes an hour and the player is exhausted for the next scenario.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%

scenes.title: Coal Country Back Roads
scenes.text: Your gamble sent you off I-80 onto twisting back roads through old coal and steel towns. One tiny town has blocked its main street with two school buses. A man with a megaphone shouts, "State your business!"

options.text: Wait until dark and sneak in for supplies
options.why: Could find supplies, but small-town watchmen know every shadow.
changes: risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water

options.text: Turn around and find your own way back to I-80
options.why: Safe, but it costs most of the morning.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 12.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +10 health from rest

options.text: Shout back honestly: you're passing through and can trade
options.why: Small towns respect honesty. The mayor trades the player gas for news and shows them a shortcut back to I-80.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Drive around the barricade through the cemetery
options.why: The town sees it as an attack. Warning shots, and the player is chased off.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: Stranded in the Snow
scenes.text: Your car slides off the highway into a deep snowbank on the open plains. It won't budge. It's -8°F, and a farmhouse light glows about three miles away.
scenes.weather_note: -8°F is a fictional storm (detour/callback scenes have no fixed stop).

options.text: Walk to the farmhouse light
options.why: Looks like the obvious move, but three miles at -8°F in the dark leads to hypothermia, and lights on flat land are farther than they look.

options.text: Wave down the next set of headlights
options.why: Could be help. Could be raiders who now know the player is stuck.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Stay with the car, tie a bright cloth to the antenna, and run the engine 10 minutes an hour
options.why: Looks like giving up, but staying with the vehicle is the top winter survival rule. A plow driver spots the cloth by morning.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Dig the tires out using a hubcap as a shovel
options.why: It works after two hours of exhausting work.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%

scenes.title: The Voice on the CB Radio
scenes.text: Your risky choice put you near a lonely weather station on the plains. Your CB radio crackles: a meteorologist inside says she'll share the storm forecast in exchange for food.

options.text: Thank her and keep driving
options.why: Safe, but the player drives blind into the weather.

options.text: Invite her to come with you to Salt Lake City
options.why: A smart ally, but she's injured and slows the player down.

options.text: Drive over and trade a can of food for the forecast
options.why: She shows the player a calm-weather window to cross the mountains. Code option: skip one bad-weather penalty later.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Hand over all your food for the forecast
options.why: Info is useful, but the player is now starving for the last days.

scenes.title: The Aching Arm
scenes.text: Two scenarios ago you scraped your arm. Now it throbs under your sleeve, red and warm to the touch. Your companion glances at it. Was it the fence, or something else?

options.text: Hide it under your sleeve and say nothing
options.why: Looks like the way to avoid panic, but the scrape gets infected, and when the companion finds out, trust is broken.

options.text: Clean it with soap and water, bandage it, and tell your companion to watch you for a day
options.why: Truth: it's from the chain-link fence, not a bite. Cleaning stops a real infection, and honesty keeps the companion's trust.

options.text: Pour alcohol from the first-aid kit on it and keep moving
options.why: It disinfects the wound, but stings badly, and the companion still worries.

options.text: Ask your companion to check for teeth marks
options.why: They find none, but now they're nervous around the player for the rest of the trip.

scenes.title: The Boy's Secret
scenes.text: The boy from the rest stop has been quiet. Tonight he finally whispers that his dad got bitten at a gas station two days before you found them, and he's scared he's sick too.

options.text: Leave him at the next town just to be safe
options.why: He isn't infected. Abandoning a child is a heavy story penalty.

options.text: Tie his wrists "just for tonight"
options.why: Looks cautious, but it terrifies him, and he runs away during the night.

options.text: Gently check him for bites and promise you'll keep him safe
options.why: No bites anywhere. He's just scared. He becomes a loyal helper who spots danger first.

options.text: Comfort him, but don't check
options.why: He feels better, but the player never knows for sure.

flags.gets: The lobby group writes your name on their survivor list and radios it ahead to the western safe zones.
flags.payoff: Give the guards your name from the Fort Lee survivor list

flags.gets: The cabin owner draws you a map of Wyoming ranch roads and private fuel tanks.
flags.payoff: Follow the hunter's map to a ranch's private fuel tank

conds.text: Trade food for gasoline from the rail yard's drums
Tell the soldiers you've been bitten and ask for their medic
Drive the whiteout in a snowplow's fresh tracks

cities.route: Mass Pike > Hartford > Hudson River > Pennsylvania I-81 > Shenandoah Valley > Tennessee I-40 > Memphis > Arkansas > Oklahoma > Texas Panhandle > Albuquerque
cities.profile_old: A dense start (about 13,900 people per square mile). The route heads south and gets warmer, but the Oklahoma ice and the Panhandle blizzard hit hard late. Water is the big problem in the dry New Mexico high desert on the final day, so filling up before then matters.
cities.profile: A dense start (Suffolk County: about 13,190 people per square mile, 2023 Census). The route heads south and gets warmer, but the Oklahoma ice and the Panhandle blizzard hit hard late. Water is the big problem in the dry New Mexico high desert on the final day, so filling up before then matters.

scenes.title: Nor'easter Lockdown
scenes.text: A nor'easter is burying Boston in snow. The news says the airport is running evacuation flights. Screams echo from the street, and your building's front door just shattered.

options.text: Run for the airport evacuation flights
options.why: Sounds official, but the airport is reached through tunnels and is mobbed. Overrun by noon.

options.text: Take the back stairs to your car and drive west on the Mass Pike now
options.why: Get out early before the roads clog. The Pike leads straight to the route west.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Fill every pot with tap water, then shelter in the basement
options.why: Good water supply, but the city's infection is climbing fast.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Steal a boat across the harbor
options.why: Out of the crowds, but rough winter seas.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

scenes.title: The Fire Station
scenes.text: Snow stops you in Worcester. A fire station sits with its bay doors shut. A college dorm has lights on. Down the street, a hospital is surrounded by people.
scenes.place: between Boston, MA and Hudson Valley, NY

options.text: Go to the hospital for help
options.why: Hospitals are where the infected were taken. Overrun.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

options.text: Get into the fire station
options.why: Medical kits, heavy coats, a water tank and steel bay doors. Firefighters are built for emergencies.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 0, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 0.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Sleep in an abandoned church
options.why: Quiet, but its big windows are easy to break.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Knock at the college dorm
options.why: The students share pizza, but they're disorganized and loud.
changes: now also sets DORM_ROSTER: The dorm adds you to its skills roster as their supply runner and stamps it.

scenes.title: The Radio Host
scenes.text: Hartford is dark except for one radio tower. A DJ is broadcasting, begging travelers to help restart his failing generator. Infected are gathering at the station's fence.

options.text: Ask him to broadcast that you're looking for allies
options.why: Allies might hear, and so might raiders.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Raid the station's supplies while he's distracted
options.why: He sees everything and broadcasts the player's car description to everyone listening.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Help him fix the generator
options.why: He shares road reports for the whole route and broadcasts warnings ahead. A great ally. Sets DJ_ALLY.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Keep driving and listen while his signal lasts
options.why: Free information without helping, but the broadcast dies within the hour.

scenes.title: The Abandoned Checkpoint
scenes.text: The bridge over the Hudson River has an abandoned army checkpoint: sandbags, bodies, and a military Humvee with the keys in it. One of the bodies twitches.
scenes.place: between Hudson Valley, NY and Harrisburg, PA

options.text: Turn back to find another bridge 40 miles away
options.why: A huge waste of time and fuel in the snow.

options.text: Drive straight through the checkpoint
options.why: Safe crossing, no bonus.

options.text: Search the bodies for weapons
options.why: Some aren't fully dead.
changes: risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water
time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Take the Humvee and drive
options.why: Looks like overkill, but it's armored, four-wheel drive, and stocked with ready-to-eat meals.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 20): you can only carry so much
now also sets ARMY_RADIO: The Humvee's radio is still tuned to the National Guard channel.

scenes.title: Nuclear Sirens
scenes.text: Near the Three Mile Island nuclear plant, sirens wail. The radio warns of a possible radiation leak. The wind blows from the south.

options.text: Keep heading southwest, windows up, air on recirculate
options.why: Moves against the wind, away from where the plume is headed.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Shelter in a basement for a day
options.why: Actually the official advice, but it costs a full day.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 25 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +15 health from rest

options.text: Break into a pharmacy for iodine pills
options.why: Iodine protects the thyroid, but break-ins are dangerous.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Detour north to get away from the plant
options.why: Feels smart, but wind from the south carries radiation north, right where the player would go.

scenes.title: The Caverns
scenes.text: In Virginia's Shenandoah Valley, you reach a huge underground cave that stays about 54°F all year. The visitor center has vending machines. You hear moaning in the dark tunnels below.
scenes.place: between Harrisburg, PA and Nashville, TN

options.text: Barricade yourself in the visitor center
options.why: Warm air from the caves, vending machine food and drinks, and lockable doors.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Go deep into the caves to sleep where it's warm
options.why: Warm, but pitch-black, easy to get lost, and the moaning is the infected.

options.text: Drive the valley at night
options.why: More miles, but deer and infected on dark roads.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Sleep in your car in the lot
options.why: Cold, but okay.

scenes.title: The Hitchhiker
scenes.text: Near Knoxville, a hitchhiker with a guitar case waves you down in freezing rain. He says he knows a back way around Nashville's gridlock. He's soaked and shaking.

options.text: Pick him up but check the guitar case first
options.why: It holds a real guitar and a map. He's honest, and his shortcut saves hours. Sets HITCHHIKER.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Pick him up with no questions
options.why: He's honest, but the player got lucky. Sets HITCHHIKER.

options.text: Take his guitar case and drive off
options.why: He was telling the truth. Bad karma, and the player loses the shortcut.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Toss him a water bottle and drive on
options.why: Kind, and no risk, but no shortcut either.

scenes.title: Music City
scenes.text: Nashville's honky-tonks are still blaring music on a loop. The noise has drawn every infected downtown. A pharmacy sits dark two blocks from the music.
scenes.place: between Nashville, TN and Memphis, TN

options.text: Head toward the music to look for survivors
options.why: It's not survivors. It's an automatic playlist and a crowd of infected.

options.text: Wait outside the city until dawn
options.why: Safe.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 7 h story delay, injury chance 10% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Raid the pharmacy while they're distracted
options.why: Medicine and bottled water, but the player is in the middle of the city.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Take the bypass around downtown while the music distracts them
options.why: Use the noise as cover.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: The Gap in the Bridge
scenes.text: The I-40 bridge over the Mississippi at Memphis has a 10-foot gap blown out by the military. Infected are wandering onto the bridge behind you.

options.text: Floor it and try to jump the gap
options.why: This isn't a movie. The car falls into the river.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

options.text: Use the other bridge one mile south
options.why: An easy detour. Always look for alternatives.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Cross by boat
options.why: Strong currents and freezing water.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Wait for army engineers to fix it
options.why: They're working on it, but it takes days.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 43 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +15 health from rest

unlocked.text: Radio the Guard engineers on the Humvee channel and cross with their convoy
unlocked.why: The engineers are laying a temporary span. You cross behind their trucks.

scenes.title: The Church Rule
scenes.text: In Little Rock, a church group offers a hot meal and shelter, but everyone must hand over their weapons at the door. Inside, you smell soup.
scenes.place: between Memphis, TN and Amarillo, TX

options.text: Hand over your main weapon and respect the rules
options.why: Builds trust. Soup, filled water jugs, and the weapon is returned in the morning.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Threaten them to let you in armed
options.why: They're armed too. A bad outcome.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

options.text: Refuse and sleep in a laundromat down the street
options.why: The player keeps their weapons, but it's a cold, glass-front building.

options.text: Hand over all your weapons
options.why: Probably safe, but the player is defenseless if things go wrong.

scenes.title: The Nation's Checkpoint
scenes.text: At the Oklahoma line, Cherokee Nation tribal police run a well-organized checkpoint with medical tents and a water truck.

options.text: Follow their rules and accept a medical check
options.why: Organized communities are the safest. Medical care, water and road intel.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 0, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Sneak around the checkpoint
options.why: Caught trespassing. The player loses their trust and help.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Offer a trade and pass through quickly
options.why: Fair and quick, but no medical check.

options.text: Ask to join them permanently
options.why: They might say yes, but the player abandons the mission.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

conditional.text: Volunteer an hour at the checkpoint for emergency fuel
conditional.why: The tribal police trade fuel for help unloading the water truck.

conditional.text: Ask the medical tent to check a bite you've been hiding
conditional.why: They have the medicine and the training.

scenes.title: Steakhouse in a Blizzard
scenes.text: A blizzard hits Amarillo. A famous roadside steakhouse has lights on and smoke rising. Someone's grilling, and the smell is incredible.
scenes.place: between Amarillo, TX and Santa Rosa area, NM

options.text: Sleep in a grain silo
options.why: Out of the wind, but cold and hungry.

options.text: Drive on through the blizzard
options.why: High winds on the flat plains. Whiteout.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Sneak in through the kitchen
options.why: Mistaken for a raider. Shots fired.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Knock and offer a trade
options.why: Survivors are cooking all the meat before it spoils. Hot food and a warm night.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 40, water 15): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

conditional.text: Drive on through the blizzard behind a sand truck
conditional.why: The sand truck helps, until it turns off.

scenes.title: The Blue Hole
scenes.text: In Santa Rosa, New Mexico, a natural spring 80 feet deep steams in the 15°F air. The water is 64°F. The high desert ahead is bone dry.
scenes.weather_note: 15°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 37.4°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Skip it to save time
options.why: The player is low on water. Bad later.

options.text: Refill every water container you have
options.why: Clean water that doesn't freeze, and the desert ahead has none.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 0, water 45): you can only carry so much
time 0.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Fill one bottle and keep moving
options.why: A little water, quickly.

options.text: Swim in it to warm up
options.why: Feels warm for a moment, but wet clothes at 15°F mean hypothermia.

scenes.title: The Gate Interview
scenes.text: At the Albuquerque safe zone gate, guards ask what skills you have to offer. Behind you, the infected are gathering in the dark.
scenes.gate_check: Every final gate now runs a screening check before admission. Not infected: admitted. Infected but not turned: quarantine with treatment (90%, fictional). The clock still matters: if a time penalty pushes arrival past Day 7 midnight, the ending is TOO LATE. No single choice at the gate ends the game by itself anymore.

options.text: Lie and say you're a doctor
options.effects_text: caught by one question: back of the line, 8 h
options.why: They ask you to name a medicine dose. You can't.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Refuse to give up your vehicle
options.effects_text: 2 h of arguing; vehicle impounded anyway
options.why: You get in, minus the car and two hours.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Tell them your real skills
options.effects_text: 1 h; admitted
options.why: Honest skills are what they need.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Offer your supplies
options.effects_text: 1 h; -15 food, -15 water
options.why: Accepted, but you arrive with nothing.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

unlocked.text: Show the dorm's stamped skills roster
unlocked.effects_text: 0.5 h; counts as a proven skill
unlocked.why: Paper proof of a useful skill. The interviewer waves you through to screening.

scenes.title: The Fire Escape
scenes.text: Your bad choice sent you into an apartment building, and infected are coming up the stairwell. You're on the third floor with an icy fire escape outside the window.

options.text: Barricade the apartment door with the couch
options.why: It holds for a few hours, but the player loses most of the day.

options.text: Hide in a closet and wait for them to leave
options.why: Looks safe, but the infected hear breathing. A dead end.

options.text: Jump from the fire escape into a snow-covered dumpster
options.why: Soft landing or a twisted ankle. Fifty-fifty.

options.text: Climb up the fire escape to the roof
options.why: The infected are slow on ladders. The player crosses to the next building's roof and comes down the far side.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: Wrong Turn into the Mountains
scenes.text: Your risky detour put you on a winding road into the mountains. You find an old summer camp with log cabins, a dining hall, and smoke from one chimney.

options.text: Call out from the road and wait for an answer
options.why: A camp caretaker answers. He gives the player a warm cabin and a map back to the interstate.

options.text: Walk into the dining hall without calling out
options.why: A group of infected was locked inside the dining hall, and the player opens the door on them.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Turn around and find the highway
options.why: Safe, but lost hours.

options.text: Search the empty cabins for supplies
options.why: Some blankets and food, but the player loses time and could meet trouble.
changes: risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water

scenes.title: Lost on the Back Roads
scenes.text: Your bad choice put you on twisty rural back roads with a quarter tank. A family on a porch is passing a jar of homemade liquor and offers you some to "warm up."

options.text: Politely decline and ask for directions back to the interstate
options.why: They point the player to a gravel shortcut and trade a gas can.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Ask to sleep in their barn
options.why: Friendly, but the barn is close to the woods where the infected wander.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Find your own way back
options.why: Hours lost on the twisting roads.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%

options.text: Drink the liquor to warm up
options.why: Feels warm, but alcohol makes the body lose heat faster. A real winter myth that leads to hypothermia.

scenes.title: Old Highway Ghost Town
scenes.text: Your gamble took you off the interstate onto an old two-lane highway and into a ghost town. An abandoned gas station still has fuel in its old pumps, and a hand crank.

options.text: Skip it and head back to the interstate
options.why: Safe, but the player is still low on fuel.

options.text: Search the old motel for supplies
options.why: Some useful items, but a family of infected took shelter there.
changes: risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water
time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Light a lantern to see the pump better
options.why: An open flame near old fuel pumps. Fire.

options.text: Hand-crank the old pump to fill up
options.why: It works. A full tank with zero crowds.

scenes.title: A Voice on the Radio
scenes.text: The radio crackles. It's the DJ from Hartford whose generator you fixed: "To the traveler who helped me, raiders on I-81 are faking car crashes to stop drivers. Don't stop for wrecks!"

options.text: Thank him on the radio and plan to drive past any wrecks
options.why: The player avoids a raider trap later. Code option: cancel one future raider penalty.

options.text: Note the warning and keep going
options.why: Fine.

options.text: Ask him if he knows any safe route around I-81
options.why: He gives a longer back-road route. Safer from raiders, but slower.

options.text: Broadcast your exact location to thank him
options.why: Raiders listen to the radio too.

scenes.title: The Bleeding Hand
scenes.text: The hitchhiker you picked up two scenarios ago has a bandage on his hand that's soaking through with blood. He says he cut it on a broken guitar string.

options.text: Look at the cut yourself, then clean and rebandage it
options.why: It's a clean straight cut from a guitar string. Not a bite. Trust grows.

options.text: Kick him out of the car without checking
options.why: He was telling the truth, and he's now alone in the cold.

options.text: Hand him the first-aid kit and keep driving
options.why: Fine, but the player never sees the wound.

options.text: Make him sit in the back seat with his hands tied
options.why: Looks careful, but it destroys trust, and he leaves at the next stop.

cities.route: I-70 West: Ohio > Indianapolis > St. Louis > Kansas City > Kansas plains > Denver > Rocky Mountain tunnel > Utah desert > I-15 > Las Vegas
cities.profile_old: Mid-size cold city. Bridges and farms early, the empty plains in the middle, then the hardest stretch of any route: the Rockies in winter and 106 miles of Utah desert with no services. Food and water must be stocked before Day 6.

scenes.title: City of Bridges
scenes.text: The Fort Pitt Tunnel is jammed solid, and horns are blaring. In the rearview mirror, you see infected climbing over cars toward the tunnel entrance.

options.text: Ride the incline railway up Mount Washington to hide
options.why: Great view, but the player could get trapped up top.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Stay in the tunnel traffic
options.why: It's moving slowly, but when the infected reach the tunnel, nobody can get out.

options.text: Leave the car and cross the West End Bridge on foot
options.why: Walks past the jam. A car with keys and a cooler of drinks waits on the far side.

options.text: Shelter in the university's 42-story tower
options.why: Tall and defensible, but the player is still in the city.
changes: now also sets TOWER_RADIO: From the 42nd floor you copy down the emergency radio frequencies.

scenes.title: Horse-and-Buggy Country
scenes.text: In eastern Ohio, an Amish family with no electricity seems untouched by the chaos. Their lanterns glow. Their dogs are barking at something in the dark field behind you.
scenes.place: between Pittsburgh, PA and Indianapolis, IN

options.text: Try to convince them to flee with you
options.why: They'll refuse, and the player loses time while the barking gets closer.

options.text: Camp at the edge of their farm
options.why: Safe, but cold, and the family stays wary.

options.text: Ask to stay in the barn and help with chores
options.why: They welcome help. Fresh bread, well water and a warm barn, and the dogs keep watch.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Steal one of their horses
options.why: They're peaceful, but the community turns the player away into the dark field.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Speedway
scenes.text: At the Indianapolis Motor Speedway, race cars sit in the garages and a maintenance pickup is parked by the pits. Infected are stumbling across the infield toward you.

options.text: Take the four-wheel-drive pickup from the maintenance lot
options.why: Practical and built for winter. A case of water bottles is in the bed.

options.text: Fill gas cans with race fuel and leave
options.why: Works short term, but it isn't great for a normal engine.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one
now also sets RACE_FUEL: You carry two cans of high-octane race fuel.

options.text: Cut through downtown Indy to save time
options.why: A big city means more infected.

options.text: Take a race car
options.why: The fastest car around, but it has no heater, sits inches off the ground and is useless in snow.

scenes.title: The Promise
scenes.text: At a giant roadside cross in Effingham, Illinois, survivors huddle around fires. Their leader offers you fuel and food if you'll take a sick little girl to the Las Vegas safe zone.
scenes.place: between Indianapolis, IN and St. Louis, MO

options.text: Agree, but check her for bites first
options.why: No bites. It's an ear infection. Fuel, food and a grateful ally. Sets CARRYING_CHILD.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 0): you can only carry so much
time 0.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Take the supplies and leave without the child
options.why: They have guns, and the player has broken a promise.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Politely refuse
options.why: Safe, but no fuel and no food.

options.text: Agree without checking her
options.why: Probably fine, but risky. Sets CARRYING_CHILD.

conditional.text: Skip the camp and drive through the night to Kansas
conditional.why: You make up time on empty interstate, tired and alone.

scenes.title: The Gateway Arch
scenes.text: In St. Louis, a crowd of infected is crossing the main bridge toward you from the Missouri side. The 630-foot Gateway Arch towers overhead, and a tram runs to the top.

options.text: Drive north to the next bridge before the crowd reaches you
options.why: A short detour around the crowd.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Race across the main bridge before the crowd reaches the middle
options.why: Maybe the player makes it, maybe they plow into the crowd.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Pull back and wait on the Illinois side for an hour
options.why: Safe, but slow.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 7 h story delay, injury chance 25% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Ride the Arch tram to the top to wait it out
options.why: Looks unreachable, but if the power fails the player is trapped 630 feet up with one way out.

scenes.title: Kansas City Barbecue
scenes.text: In Kansas City, barbecue smoke drifts from a famous BBQ joint. Survivors are cooking all the meat before it spoils. A guard at the door says, "Trade or move on."
scenes.place: between St. Louis, MO and Goodland, KS

options.text: Trade a gas can for food and water
options.why: Hot food, water and a warning about the empty Kansas plains ahead.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 40, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Raid their meat locker
options.why: They see the player. A bad outcome.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Offer to join them for a few days
options.why: Comfortable and well fed, but the player loses time.

options.text: Keep driving through the city
options.why: Safe, but hungry.

scenes.title: Last Gas for 80 Miles
scenes.text: Western Kansas: 100 miles between towns. A sign says "Last Gas for 80 Miles." The station is dark, and its door is propped open with a body.

options.text: Siphon gas from abandoned cars outside
options.why: It works, but slowly.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%

options.text: Grab snacks from the front of the store
options.why: The food is still there, and so is whoever propped the door open.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Search the station's storage room for gas cans and bottled water
options.why: Gas cans and a pallet of bottled water are stored in back.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 0, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Keep going with half a tank
options.why: The player might not make it to the next town.

conditional.text: Hand-pump the station's underground tank
conditional.why: Slow work at a dark station, but the tank is nearly full.

scenes.title: Denver Lights
scenes.text: Denver's skyline is lit. Someone has the power running. On the radio, a voice invites survivors to a stadium downtown.
scenes.place: between Goodland, KS and Summit County (Rockies), CO

options.text: Visit the stadium where survivors are gathering
options.why: Could be good. Could be a trap.

options.text: Head into the city to find the survivors
options.why: Light means people, and people mean infected.

options.text: Drive through the city at night
options.why: Possible, but crowded roads.

options.text: Camp in the foothills outside the city
options.why: Away from the crowds, with a clear creek for water.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

conditional.text: Go to the stadium's medical tent and admit the bite
conditional.why: The crowd is risky, but the medics are real.

scenes.title: Into the Rockies
scenes.text: I-70 climbs toward the Eisenhower Tunnel, over 11,000 feet up. Snow is falling hard. An avalanche warning flashes on a sign. Your tires are slipping.

options.text: Put on tire chains before climbing
options.why: Required by Colorado law in storms, and life-saving.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Wait at the bottom for the storm to pass
options.why: Safe, but it costs most of a day.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 31 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +15 health from rest

options.text: Take Loveland Pass over the top instead
options.why: Steep, icy and closed in storms.

options.text: Speed up the mountain to beat the snow
options.why: Black ice on curves. A crash.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

scenes.title: Hot Springs
scenes.text: In Glenwood Springs, a giant natural hot spring pool steams in the 10°F night air. The spa building next to it is dark but unlocked.
scenes.place: between Summit County (Rockies), CO and Grand Junction, CO to Utah desert

options.text: Sleep in the spa building
options.why: Warm from the springs, with a snack bar and drinking fountains.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Rent a room in town above a closed shop

options.text: Soak in the hot springs
options.why: Feels amazing until the player gets out wet at 10°F. Sets SOAKED.

options.text: Drive through the canyon at night
options.why: Rockfall and ice on the canyon road, and nowhere to pull over.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

scenes.text: In Utah, I-70 enters the San Rafael Swell: 106 miles with no gas, no food and no help. A last rest stop has vending machines and a water fountain.
scenes.place: Grand Junction, CO to Utah desert

options.text: Drive in with half a tank
options.why: The player gets stranded in the desert.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Take a dirt road shortcut
options.why: Rough roads, and the player could get stuck.

options.text: Fill the water jugs only
options.why: Okay, but no food for the long drive.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Top off fuel, water and food before going in
options.why: Planning ahead is the only way to cross 106 empty miles.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 20, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

unlocked.text: Pour in the race fuel cans and go before the rest stop crowd notices
unlocked.why: The cans you filled in Indianapolis cover the 106 empty miles.

scenes.title: Desert Stars
scenes.text: The Utah desert night drops to 15°F. A lonely gas station glows in the distance. Hidden canyons line the road.
scenes.place: between Grand Junction, CO to Utah desert and Las Vegas approach, NV
scenes.weather_note: 15°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 38.6°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Sleep under a rock overhang beside the road
options.why: Out of the wind, but visible from the highway.

options.text: Drive on with gas-station coffee
options.why: The player covers miles, but falling asleep at the wheel is a real danger.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Go to the gas station
options.why: Light in the middle of nowhere attracts every infected for miles.

options.text: Camp in a hidden canyon with your car
options.why: Hidden and out of the wind.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: The Gorge
scenes.text: Near Las Vegas, the Virgin River Gorge is a narrow, curving canyon. A crashed bus blocks one lane, and its doors are banging open and shut.

options.text: Wait for someone else to move it
options.why: Nobody comes. Hours wasted.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 10 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Drive slowly around the bus in the clear lane
options.why: The lane is clear enough.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Climb the canyon wall on foot
options.why: Steep, icy rock with gear on the player's back.

options.text: Push the bus out of the way
options.why: It won't move, the player damages the car, and the noise wakes whatever is inside.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Vegas Lights
scenes.text: Las Vegas! The safe zone is a fortified hotel complex. The Strip is lit up like nothing happened, and the infected are crowding the casinos.
scenes.gate_check: Every final gate now runs a screening check before admission. Not infected: admitted. Infected but not turned: quarantine with treatment (90%, fictional). options.text: Drive down the Strip to the safe zone
options.effects_text: cornered by crowds: -15 health, 4 h detour
options.why: The lights draw every infected in the city.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Wait until morning
options.effects_text: 10 h; enter if before the deadline

changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Signal the gate with your headlights
options.effects_text: 2 h; injury risk 30%

options.text: Take the back road the radio described
options.effects_text: 1 h; admitted

changes: rewritten final-gate option

unlocked.text: Call the gate on the emergency frequency and ask for an escort

scenes.title: Overrun at the Rest Stop
scenes.text: Your bad choice put you at a highway rest stop just as a crowd of infected stumbles out of the woods. You're 50 feet from your car.

options.text: Lock yourself in the restroom
options.why: Looks safe, but there's one door and no window. The player is trapped.

changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Hide in the rest stop's storage room
options.why: It works, but the player waits hours for them to leave.

options.text: Grab a tire iron and fight your way to the car
options.why: The player could make it. Or get bitten.
changes: risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water

scenes.title: The Frozen Caves
scenes.text: Your gamble took you off I-70 into a state park with frozen waterfalls and giant rock caves. A group of hikers has camped inside a huge recess cave.

options.text: Climb the icy cliff for a better view

changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Join the hikers and share a fire

changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Spend the night alone in a smaller cave

options.text: Thank them and head back to I-70

scenes.text: Your bad choice has you coming down a steep Colorado mountain grade when your brakes overheat and stop working. A sign flashes: "Runaway Truck Ramp 1 Mile."

options.text: Scrape the car along the guardrail to slow down

changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Steer into the runaway truck ramp

changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Open the door and jump out
options.why: Jumping from a moving car is deadly.

scenes.title: The Uranium Ghost Town
scenes.text: Your detour took you off I-70 into an abandoned uranium-mining town in the desert. Old houses, a well, and a rusty sign warning of radiation.

options.text: Drink from the town's well

options.text: Search the old houses for supplies
