scenes.text: The little girl you agreed to carry west wakes up crying and holding her arm. There's a red, puffy mark on her wrist you didn't notice before.

options.text: Keep her warm and watch her closely
options.why: Fine, but the player stays worried for days.

options.text: Check the mark closely in good light
options.why: It's chilblains, a skin reaction to cold, not a bite. Warm her hands slowly, and she's fine.

options.text: Leave her with strangers at the next stop
options.why: She wasn't infected, and the player broke a promise to her family.

options.text: Rub the mark with snow to calm the swelling
options.why: Looks like first aid, but snow makes cold injuries worse.

scenes.title: Shivering in the Dark
scenes.text: Two scenarios after you soaked in the hot springs, you're still shivering hard, your fingers are clumsy, and you're slurring a little. Your companion is worried.

options.text: Keep moving to warm up
options.why: Light movement helps, but pushing hard while confused is dangerous.

options.text: Take a hot shower to warm up fast
options.why: Looks like the fastest fix, but rapid heat can shock the body. Warm up gradually.

options.text: Huddle with your companion under blankets
options.why: It works, but slowly.

options.text: Get into dry clothes and a sleeping bag, and drink something warm and sweet
options.why: These are signs of mild hypothermia. Dry layers and warm sugary drinks are the right treatment.

flags.gets: From the 42nd floor you copy down the emergency radio frequencies.
flags.payoff: Call the gate on the emergency frequency and ask for an escort

flags.gets: You carry two cans of high-octane race fuel.
flags.payoff: Pour in the race fuel cans and go before the rest stop crowd notices

conds.text: Hand-pump the station's underground tank
Go to the stadium's medical tent and admit the bite
Skip the camp and drive through the night to Kansas

cities.route: I-80 East: Parleys Canyon > Wyoming > Nebraska > Iowa > south of Chicago > Ohio > Pennsylvania > New Jersey > New York City
cities.profile_old: Mid-size, well-prepared city. Many Utah families keep emergency food storage, so the player can start well stocked. Wyoming's cold hits on Day 2. The player ends in the most infected city in the game, New York, so the last day is the hardest. Safe zone: Governors Island in New York Harbor.
cities.profile: Mid-size, well-prepared city. Many Utah families keep emergency food storage, so the player can start well stocked. Wyoming's cold hits on Day 2. The player ends in the most infected city in the game, New York, so the last day is the hardest. Safe zone: Governors Island in New York Harbor.

scenes.title: Emergency Food Storage
scenes.text: Salt Lake City is tense. Your neighbor Ruth's basement holds a year of emergency food and water. She offers to share, but the infected just broke into the house across the street.

options.text: Grab her food while she isn't looking
options.why: She notices. The player loses a friend, and the noise draws the infected.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Take a small share and leave alone
options.why: Enough supplies for a few days, but no ally.

options.text: Help Ruth pack fast and leave together
options.why: The player gains a skilled ally and a trunk full of food and water. Sets NEIGHBOR_ALLY.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 40, water 40): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Decline, since you'll find food on the road
options.why: The player starts underprepared.

scenes.title: Parleys Canyon
scenes.text: Parleys Canyon is the only interstate east. It's steep, icy and jammed with cars trying to escape. Headlights are flickering out, and car doors are opening.
scenes.place: between Salt Lake City, UT and Laramie, WY

options.text: Wait in the jam
options.why: The infected work their way through the stalled cars.

options.text: Take a back road through the hills
options.why: Slow and winding, but the player is past the jam by midnight.

options.text: Take a snowcat from a ski resort maintenance yard
options.why: Built for snow and mountains. It drives right around the jam.
changes: now also sets SKI_RADIO: The snowcat has a ski-patrol radio that reaches state police.

options.text: Drive on the shoulder
options.why: Ice and rock walls.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

scenes.title: Frozen Stiff in Laramie
scenes.text: In Laramie it's -12°F. The infected on the streets are frozen nearly solid. A grocery store sits unguarded across the street, and some houses on the edge of town look untouched.
scenes.weather_note: -12°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 21.9°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Drive through town without stopping
options.why: Safe, but the player misses the best supply run in Wyoming.

options.text: Search the houses on the edge of town
options.why: Some food, but the player scrapes their hand climbing through a broken window. Sets SCRAPED_HAND.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Poke a frozen infected to see if it's dead
options.why: Looks harmless, but its jaw still works.

options.text: Raid the grocery store quickly while the infected are frozen
options.why: The cold rule from our infection model: below 20°F, the infected slow way down. Use it.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: The University Gym
scenes.text: Survivors have barricaded the university gym in Laramie. A guard at the door says, "We don't let strangers in after dark." The temperature is falling toward -20°F.
scenes.place: between Laramie, WY and Kearney / Grand Island, NE
scenes.weather_note: -20°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 23.9°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Sleep in your car in the parking lot
options.why: Cold but safe near the guards.

options.text: Beg for supplies through the door
options.why: They might hand some out. Might not.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Offer to take a night shift on guard duty
options.why: Work earns trust. A warm cot, hot soup and water after the shift.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower
now also sets GYM_LETTER: The Laramie gym leader writes you a letter vouching for your guard shifts.

options.text: Sneak in through the side door
options.why: Caught and thrown out into -20°F.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Crashed Plane
scenes.text: A small cargo plane has crash-landed in a Nebraska field. Boxes marked with red crosses are scattered across the snow. The cockpit door is cracked open, and something is moving inside.

options.text: Look for survivors near the wreck
options.why: The co-pilot is alive but injured. A tough choice.

options.text: Search the cockpit for the pilot's gear
options.why: The pilot survived the crash, but not the infection.

options.text: Grab the medical supply boxes
options.why: Antibiotics and bandages, the rarest supplies in the game. Sets MED_SUPPLIES.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Ignore it and drive on
options.why: Safe, but the player misses valuable supplies.

scenes.title: The Museum Over the Highway
scenes.text: In Kearney, Nebraska, a museum built as a bridge stretches right over I-80. Survivors inside are lowering a rope ladder. Infected wander the highway below.
scenes.place: between Kearney / Grand Island, NE and Quad Cities, IA

options.text: Sleep under the bridge
options.why: The infected wander the highway at night.

options.text: Camp in a Kearney motel parking lot
options.why: Okay, but the motel has broken doors and wanderers.

options.text: Climb the rope ladder and stay with them
options.why: High above the road with one way in. They share dinner.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower
tagged HIDDEN GEM: sounds timid or slow, works best

options.text: Keep driving through the night
options.why: Empty Nebraska roads, where a breakdown means no help.

conditional.text: Siphon cars in the motel lot
conditional.why: A few gallons from each car adds up.

scenes.title: The World's Largest Truck Stop
scenes.text: In Walcott, Iowa, the world's largest truck stop is now a survivor marketplace. Truckers are trading fuel, food and parts out of their trailers. A fight breaks out nearby.

options.text: Search the abandoned trucks at the back of the lot
options.why: Food, but some cabs aren't empty.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Fuel up and keep driving
options.why: Fine, but the player has no spare tire for the rest of the trip.

options.text: Trade for food and a spare tire, then leave before the fight spreads
options.why: A spare tire saves the player from a blowout later. Sets SPARE_TIRE.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 0): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Try to steal from a trailer during the fight
options.why: Truckers watch each other's backs. Caught.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: Bite Check at the River
scenes.text: At the Mississippi River bridge into Illinois, soldiers check every traveler for bites. A long line of cars waits in the cold. Someone ahead of you starts to panic.
scenes.place: between Quad Cities, IA and Cleveland, OH

options.text: Offer the soldiers supplies to skip the line
options.why: Might work. Might get the player searched more closely.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Find another bridge
options.why: Safe, but it costs half a day.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 12.5 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +10 health from rest

options.text: Run the checkpoint
options.why: Soldiers open fire, and the player is now wanted at every checkpoint east.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Wait your turn and show you're clean
options.why: The player passes safely and gets water and a stamped travel pass.

conditional.text: Admit the bite at the checkpoint and ask the army medics for treatment
conditional.why: Soldiers screen for bites because they can treat early ones.

scenes.title: Fleeing Chicago
scenes.text: Smoke rises over Chicago. A line of survivors on foot is walking west past your car, carrying everything they own. A woman bangs on your window, begging for water.

options.text: Give her a bottle and ask which roads are clear
options.why: People leaving an area know it best. They point the player to a clear route south of the jam.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower
tagged HIDDEN GEM: sounds timid or slow, works best

options.text: Head into the city to look for supplies
options.why: Chicago is huge and heavily infected.

options.text: Keep driving without stopping
options.why: Fine, but the player drives into the I-80 jam the survivors knew about.

options.text: Offer a family a ride
options.why: A good deed, but more mouths to feed and slower travel.

scenes.title: Ice Fishing on Lake Erie
scenes.text: Near Cleveland, Lake Erie is frozen. Survivors are ice fishing near the shore around small heaters. Farther out, the ice is dark and wet.
scenes.place: between Cleveland, OH and Morris County suburbs, NJ

options.text: Walk farther out on the ice to find your own fishing spot
options.why: Looks productive, but the ice gets thinner farther out.

options.text: Keep driving along the lake
options.why: Fine, but lake-effect snow is building.

options.text: Camp on the shore with them overnight
options.why: A friendly night, but the player loses time in the morning.

options.text: Trade gas for fresh fish and a pot of boiled lake water
options.why: Fresh protein and safe water. They share their weather radio too.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: The Mountain Trooper
scenes.text: I-80 climbs through Pennsylvania's mountains in falling snow. A state police car blocks the road with its lights flashing. The trooper inside isn't moving.

options.text: Speed past the police car
options.why: Straight onto the collapsed bridge.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

options.text: Wait for the plow to clear the road
options.why: Safe, but it costs half a day.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 19 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +15 health from rest

options.text: Stop at a distance, call out, and check before getting close
options.why: He's alive but injured. He warns of a collapsed bridge ahead and shows the detour.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Run up and open his door
options.why: He's alive, but the player got lucky.

unlocked.text: Call the trooper on the ski-patrol radio before getting close
unlocked.why: He answers. He's fine, the road ahead is clear, and he warns you about a raider spike strip.

conditional.text: Turn onto the unplowed back road around the police car
conditional.why: Faster, but deep snow and no help if you slide.

scenes.title: Suburban Fences
scenes.text: The New Jersey suburbs are quiet. Too quiet. A shopping mall glows nearby, and a house with a tall fence sits on a dead-end street.
scenes.place: between Morris County suburbs, NJ and Bayonne / Hudson County, NJ

options.text: Sleep in the house with the tall fence
options.why: Fences slow the infected, and the water heater tank holds 40 gallons of drinkable water.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 10, water 35): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Sleep in the mall
options.why: Looks like it has everything, but malls draw crowds and the infected.

options.text: Sleep in your car on the dead-end street
options.why: Fine, but there's no fence.

options.text: Search the mall food court before bed
options.why: Good food, but the player is inside a dark mall at night.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

scenes.title: The Harbor Crossing
scenes.text: At dawn you reach the Bayonne pier, take a small boat and head for Governors Island. Halfway across, the engine sputters and dies. The current pushes you toward Manhattan.

options.text: Row steadily toward the island
options.why: Slow but steady. Patrol boats spot the player and tow them in.

options.text: Wave a bright shirt to signal for help
options.why: It works eventually, but the player drifts for an hour.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 4 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%

options.text: Jump in and swim
options.why: 38°F water. Hypothermia in minutes.

options.text: Try to restart the engine over and over
options.why: Looks like the fix, but it floods the engine while the current pulls the boat away.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

scenes.title: Governors Island Dock
scenes.text: You reach the Governors Island safe zone dock. Guards tell you everyone must be quarantined for 24 hours before entering.
scenes.gate_check: Every final gate now runs a screening check before admission. Not infected: admitted. Infected but not turned: quarantine with treatment (90%, fictional). The clock still matters: if a time penalty pushes arrival past Day 7 midnight, the ending is TOO LATE. No single choice at the gate ends the game by itself anymore.

options.text: Accept the quarantine
options.effects_text: 24 h quarantine counts as arrival; admitted after
options.why: Arriving before the deadline is what counts.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Wait on the dock until the guards change shifts
options.effects_text: 8 h in the cold, then quarantine
options.why: The new shift has the same rules.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Refuse quarantine and demand entry
options.effects_text: held at gunpoint: -10 health, quarantined anyway
options.why: You go in either way, just hurt.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Argue that you've traveled 2,230 road miles
options.effects_text: 2 h; then quarantine
options.why: True, but every arrival has a story.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

unlocked.text: Hand the guards the letter from the Laramie gym leader
unlocked.why: A trusted camp vouches for you. You still quarantine, but half as long.

scenes.title: Breakdown in the Middle of Nowhere
scenes.text: Your bad choice has left your car dead on an empty stretch of highway, 40 miles from the nearest town. It's -15°F, and the wind is picking up.
scenes.weather_note: -15°F is a fictional storm (detour/callback scenes have no fixed stop).

options.text: Bundle up in every layer and wait
options.why: It works, but it's a miserable, freezing night.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 7 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Signal passing traffic with your flashlight
options.why: Could bring help. Could bring raiders.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Stay with the car, burn a candle in a coffee can for heat, and crack a window
options.why: A candle can raise a closed car's temperature a few degrees. Cracking a window prevents fumes. Staying with the car means rescuers can find the player.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Walk 40 miles to town
options.why: Looks like taking charge, but 40 miles at -15°F means death from cold.

scenes.title: The Wild Horse Wranglers
scenes.text: Your risky choice put you face to face with federal wild-horse wranglers on horseback in the Red Desert. They offer to lead you across an old ranch road.

options.text: Follow the wranglers across the ranch road
options.why: They know the land. The road bypasses a jam on I-80.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Ask them to sell you a horse
options.why: They might, but horses need care and food the player doesn't have.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Thank them and stay on I-80
options.why: Safe.

options.text: Try to take one of their horses
options.why: They outnumber the player and know horses.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: Spike Strip Ambush
scenes.text: Your bad choice led you onto a quiet stretch of highway where raiders laid a spike strip. Your front tire is flat, and you see figures walking toward you.

options.text: Lock the doors and honk to draw them off
options.why: The noise attracts infected, which scatter the raiders, but now the player is surrounded by infected.

options.text: Change to your spare tire fast and leave
options.why: Code note: needs the SPARE_TIRE flag from the World's Largest Truck Stop (SLC 8 M, Best option). Without it, show the alternate option.

alt.text: Drive slowly on the flat tire to escape
alt.note: No spare. Driving on a flat ruins the rim, but the player escapes.

changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Run on foot into the woods
options.why: Safe from the raiders, but the player loses the car.

options.text: Get out and talk to the raiders
options.why: They take everything.

scenes.title: The Old Steam Train
scenes.text: Your gamble put you in Jim Thorpe, PA, a mountain town with an old tourist steam train. Its crew says they can run it east to the Delaware River.

options.text: Thank them and drive on
options.why: Safe.

options.text: Try to steer the train yourself
options.why: The player has no idea how to run a steam engine.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Ride the steam train east
options.why: Tracks avoid the jammed interstate. A fast, safe ride.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Help them shovel coal for a ride
options.why: It works, but it's hard work and the player is exhausted.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

scenes.title: Ruth's Ankle
scenes.text: Ruth, your neighbor from Salt Lake City, slips on ice getting out of the car. Her ankle swells fast, and she can't put weight on it.

options.text: Pull and twist her foot to "pop it back in place"
options.why: Looks like quick first aid, but untrained people can make a sprain or break much worse.

options.text: Wrap the ankle, raise it, and pack snow in a cloth on it for 15 minutes
options.why: Rest, compression, elevation and cold reduce the swelling. She can limp by morning.

options.text: Leave her and keep going
options.why: She's an ally with food and skills. Abandoning her is a huge story penalty.

options.text: Help her into the back seat and keep going
options.why: Fine, but she'll be slow for days.

scenes.title: The Hot, Swollen Hand
scenes.text: The hand you scraped climbing through a window in Laramie is now hot, swollen, and red. A red line is starting to creep up your wrist.

options.text: Clean it and take antibiotics from the crashed plane's medical boxes
options.why: Code note: needs the MED_SUPPLIES flag (SLC 6 M, Best option). A red line spreading from a wound is a serious bacterial infection, and antibiotics are the right fix.

alt.text: Clean it, keep it raised, and look for a pharmacy
alt.note: Without antibiotics, the player has to hope for a pharmacy soon.

options.text: Soak it in warm salt water
options.why: Helps a little, but it isn't enough on its own.

options.text: Cut the wound open to "let the infection out"
options.why: Looks like doing something, but it can spread the infection.

options.text: Ignore it. It's not a bite
options.why: True, it's not a bite, but a spreading infection can still be deadly.

flags.gets: The snowcat has a ski-patrol radio that reaches state police.
flags.payoff: Call the trooper on the ski-patrol radio before getting close

flags.gets: The Laramie gym leader writes you a letter vouching for your guard shifts.
flags.payoff: Hand the guards the letter from the Laramie gym leader

conds.text: Siphon cars in the motel lot
Admit the bite at the checkpoint and ask the army medics for treatment
Turn onto the unplowed back road around the police car

cities.route: Jackson, WY > Hoback Canyon > I-80 at Rock Springs > Nebraska > Omaha > Iowa > Chicago > I-90 along Lake Erie > Buffalo > New York Thruway > Mass Pike > Boston
cities.profile_old: The smallest and coldest start (about 15°F). The deep cold slows the infected, but a small town has nowhere to hide. Early game: mountains, elk and snowmobiles. Late game: lake-effect snow and a crowded Northeast. Safe zone: Fort Warren on Georges Island in Boston Harbor.
cities.profile: The smallest and coldest start (January normal 16.2°F, NOAA). The deep cold slows the infected, but a small town has nowhere to hide. Early game: mountains, elk and snowmobiles. Late game: lake-effect snow and a crowded Northeast. Safe zone: Fort Warren on Georges Island in Boston Harbor.

scenes.title: The Antler Arches
scenes.text: Jackson's town square, under its famous elk-antler arches, is chaos. The only roads out are mountain passes. The sheriff is shouting through a megaphone as infected stumble out of a ski shop.

options.text: Grab food from your pantry and shelter at home
options.why: Supplies help, but in a small town the infection reaches everyone.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Ride the ski resort tram up to scout
options.why: A great view, but if the power fails the player is stuck up top.

options.text: Run to the sheriff and offer your help
options.why: Locals trust locals. He tells the player Hoback Canyon is still open and hands them water.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower
now also sets SHERIFF_LETTER: The sheriff signs a letter naming you a county volunteer.

options.text: Drive over Teton Pass to the west
options.why: Steep, icy, avalanche country in winter. Closed and deadly.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Elk Refuge
scenes.text: Thousands of elk crowd the snowy refuge outside town. Infected are coming down the road behind you, and the herd blocks the only way south.
scenes.place: between Jackson, WY and Rock Springs, WY

options.text: Hide at the refuge visitor center
options.why: Safe for the night, with a vending machine.
changes: now also sets RANGER_PHONE: A refuge ranger gives you a satellite phone number for the East Coast evacuation office.

options.text: Turn back to town for more supplies
options.why: The infected are in town now.

options.text: Drive slowly through the middle of the herd
options.why: Looks dangerous, but the elk form a living wall that slows the infected. An antler scrapes the grille. Sets ELK_DAMAGE.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Honk and scatter the elk
options.why: The stampede damages the car, and the noise draws the infected.

scenes.title: Hoback Canyon
scenes.text: Hoback Canyon is narrow and icy. A rancher's snowmobile trailer sits at a pullout. The rancher is slumped over the steering wheel of his truck.

options.text: Leave your car and ride the snowmobile out
options.why: Not enough range or storage for a cross-country trip.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Hook the snowmobile trailer to your car and go
options.why: Backup transport for deep snow later. Smart thinking ahead. Sets SNOWMOBILE.

options.text: Check on the rancher
options.why: He's turned. The player grabs his cooler but takes a risk.

options.text: Keep driving slowly through the canyon
options.why: Safe, but no backup for the deep snow ahead.

scenes.title: The Overrun Truck Stop
scenes.text: You reach I-80 at Rock Springs. The truck stop's shelves are full of food and drinks, but its doors are smeared with blood and the lights flicker inside.
scenes.place: between Rock Springs, WY and Omaha, NE

options.text: Skip the store and siphon gas from cars on the off-ramp
options.why: Avoid the crowd. Fuel is still within reach.

options.text: Grab drinks from the outdoor coolers by the pumps
options.why: Water is right there, but the infected are 50 feet away.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Coast on to the next town
options.why: Okay for now, but it's 100 empty miles.

options.text: Run in for the food and drinks
options.why: Looks like a supply jackpot, but it's overrun.

scenes.title: The Crop Duster
scenes.text: In the Nebraska Panhandle, a crop-dusting plane sits in a snowy field. The pilot waves you down. He's scouting from the air and knows where the roads are blocked.

options.text: Wave and drive on
options.why: Fine, but the player drives toward a blocked road he could have warned them about.

options.text: Ask him to fly you east
options.why: His fuel only reaches 200 miles, and the player's car stays behind.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Ask the pilot to scout your route and share what he knows
options.why: Aerial intel shows the player which roads are clear. He promises to warn them if anything changes. Sets PILOT_INTEL.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Try to take the plane
options.why: The pilot fights back.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Omaha Crossing
scenes.text: At Omaha, the Missouri River bridge into Iowa has a military checkpoint with floodlights. A soldier yells, "Last crossing tonight! Bridge closes at midnight!"
scenes.place: between Omaha, NE and Des Moines, IA

options.text: Sleep in your car and cross in the morning
options.why: The bridge is closed by morning, and the player loses a day.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 31 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +15 health from rest

options.text: Get in line and cross tonight
options.why: The player crosses before the bridge closes, and soldiers hand out ration packs.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Argue with the soldiers about the long line
options.why: Pushing makes them suspicious, and the player only just gets through.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Drive back into Omaha to find another bridge
options.why: The city is infected, and the other bridges are closed too.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

unlocked.text: Show the sheriff's letter; emergency volunteers cross first
unlocked.why: The soldiers honor it. You cross ahead of the line before the bridge closes.

conditional.text: Tell the soldiers you were bitten and ask for their medic
conditional.effects_text: 6 h; treatment 90% (fictional); cross in the morning
conditional.why: They treat you, but you miss tonight's crossing.

scenes.title: Iowa Blizzard
scenes.text: A blizzard sweeps across Iowa. Snow blows sideways and the highway disappears. A red barn is barely visible, and something is moving in the white behind you.

options.text: Keep driving in the whiteout
options.why: The player drives off the road into a snowy ditch.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Unhook the snowmobile and keep going
options.why: Fast in snow, but the player could get lost in a whiteout.

alt.text: Follow a snowplow's tracks through the storm
alt.note: No snowmobile. The plow tracks fill in fast, and the player could lose the trail.

changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Pull into the barn and wait out the storm
options.why: Out of the wind, with hay for insulation and a farmhouse well.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 0, water 25): you can only carry so much

options.text: Stop on the shoulder with the hazard lights on
options.why: Survivable, but trucks might hit the car.

conditional.text: Follow a snowplow convoy through the blizzard
conditional.why: The plows keep a lane open, at plow speed.

scenes.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
scenes.text: Near Chicago, on the shore of Lake Michigan, a lighthouse keeper's house is lit by candles. The keeper is waving a lantern from the doorway. Behind you, Chicago is burning.
scenes.place: between Des Moines, IA and Cleveland, OH

options.text: Drive the lakefront road toward Indiana
options.why: Night roads near a burning city.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Go to the keeper and ask for shelter
options.why: He's friendly, and he has canned food and rain barrels of water.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Sleep in your car by the lighthouse
options.why: Fine, but cold wind off the lake.

options.text: Climb the lighthouse in the dark to see the city
options.why: Icy steps and no light.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: Lake-Effect Whiteout
scenes.text: Near Toledo, lake-effect snow off Lake Erie is dumping two inches an hour. A plow truck is ahead of you. A car in the ditch beside you has its door hanging open.

options.text: Check the car in the ditch
options.why: A bag of groceries, and the owner nearby. Not a pleasant surprise.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Follow the plow at a safe distance
options.why: It clears the road, and its flashing lights guide the player.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Pull over and wait
options.why: Time lost, but safe.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 9 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Pass the plow to go faster
options.why: Into unplowed snow. Stuck.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

scenes.title: The Rock Museum
scenes.text: In Cleveland, the glass pyramid of a famous rock and roll museum sits on the lakefront. Survivors are playing guitars inside, and the smell of cooking drifts out.
scenes.place: between Cleveland, OH and Buffalo, NY

options.text: Camp outside the city
options.why: Fine, but cold.

options.text: Knock and introduce yourself
options.why: Friendly musicians. A warm meal, water and a morale boost.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 20): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Break in through the glass
options.why: Loud, and the survivors defend themselves.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Drive through the city at night
options.why: Infected in the streets.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

scenes.title: Four Feet of Snow
scenes.text: Overnight, Erie, Pennsylvania, got four feet of lake-effect snow. Your car is buried. Shapes are stumbling through the drifts toward you.

options.text: Unhook the snowmobile you towed from Wyoming
options.why: Looks like a gamble, but it's built for this. The player rides to the next plowed town.

alt.text: Grab a snowblower from the hardware store across the street
alt.note: No snowmobile. A snowblower clears a path to the plowed road in an hour.

changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Walk to town for help
options.why: Four feet of snow on foot.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Try to drive the car out
options.why: Stuck. The car isn't going anywhere.

options.text: Dig out by hand
options.why: Hours of shoveling, and the player is exhausted.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3.5 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%

scenes.title: Buffalo
scenes.text: Buffalo's survivors have gathered in the football stadium and are broadcasting an invitation on the radio. Across the road, a wing restaurant has a walk-in freezer.
scenes.place: between Buffalo, NY and Worcester, MA

options.text: Go to the stadium
options.why: Looks safe with all those people, but crowds turn into outbreaks.

options.text: Shelter in the wing restaurant and raid the freezer
options.why: Small, lockable and full of frozen food. Snow melted on the grill gives water.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 20): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Sleep in your car
options.why: Fine, but the car is half-buried in snow.

options.text: Drive on to Rochester
options.why: Snowy night roads.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

conditional.text: Fill up from the fuel trucks outside the stadium
conditional.why: The fuel is there because the crowd is there.

scenes.title: The Harbor Route
scenes.text: The Mass Pike into Boston is jammed. The radio says the safe zone is Fort Warren on Georges Island, and the last boats leave from the harbor tonight.

options.text: Leave the car and walk the commuter rail tracks into the city
options.why: The tracks are clear of jammed cars and lead straight toward the harbor.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Use your snowmobile on the frozen river into the city
options.why: Fast, but the river ice is thin near the harbor.

alt.text: Walk the frozen river path into the city
alt.note: No snowmobile. Walking the riverbank is slow and exposed, and the ice near the harbor is thin.

changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Wait in the suburbs for the jam to clear
options.why: Time lost, and the boat runs end tonight.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 9 h story delay, injury chance 20% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Drive into downtown Boston
options.why: Jammed streets full of the infected.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Last Boat
scenes.text: At the harbor, the last boat to Fort Warren is about to leave before the water freezes tonight. There's one seat left, and an injured nurse also needs it.
scenes.gate_check: Every final gate now runs a screening check before admission. Not infected: admitted. Infected but not turned: quarantine with treatment (90%, fictional). The clock still matters: if a time penalty pushes arrival past Day 7 midnight, the ending is TOO LATE. No single choice at the gate ends the game by itself anymore.

options.text: Fight the nurse for the seat
options.effects_text: pulled off the dock: -15 health, morning boat (10 h)
options.why: The crew sides with the nurse.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Suggest you both squeeze in and leave your heavy gear behind
options.effects_text: lose your gear; both cross now
options.why: Gear is replaceable. You both make it.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Offer the captain fuel to make an extra trip
options.effects_text: needs 5+ gal: -5 gal, both cross; otherwise morning boat (10 h)
options.why: Works only if you still have fuel to give.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Give the nurse your seat and wait for a morning boat
options.effects_text: 10 h; the nurse vouches for you at the fort
options.why: Generous, slow, and remembered.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

unlocked.text: Call the evacuation office on the ranger's satellite number
unlocked.effects_text: 1 h; a second boat is sent
unlocked.why: The office sends a second boat. The nurse and you both get across.

scenes.title: Avalanche in Hoback Canyon
scenes.text: Your bad choice left you in Hoback Canyon when a small avalanche buries the road ahead of you. A second slope above you is cracking.

options.text: Get out and dig through the snow ahead
options.why: Looks like progress, but the player is standing in the slide path when the second slope lets go.

options.text: Stay put in the car and wait
options.why: The car is a shell, but if the second slope slides, the player is buried.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 7 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Drive over the snow pile
options.why: Possible with four-wheel drive, but the car could get stuck in the path.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Back up quickly to the last wide pullout and wait for the slope to settle
options.why: Get out of the slide path first. Avalanche terrain needs patience.

scenes.title: The South Pass Ghost Town
scenes.text: Your detour took you to an old mining ghost town on the Oregon Trail. A hermit lives in one restored cabin with a wood stove and stacks of firewood.

options.text: Explore the old mine for supplies
options.why: Old mines can collapse.

options.text: Raid his woodpile while he sleeps
options.why: He's a light sleeper with a rifle.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Sleep in another empty cabin
options.why: Cold, but the player has a roof.

options.text: Knock and offer to chop wood for a night by the stove
options.why: The hermit knows the backcountry and shows the player a shortcut to I-80.
changes: time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: Stuck on Lake Erie Shore Ice
scenes.text: Your bad choice put your car sliding off a lakeside road onto the frozen shoreline of Lake Erie. The ice is cracking under the front tires.

options.text: Get out the back, slowly crawl to shore, and leave the car
options.why: Spread the body's weight and get off the ice. Cars can be replaced.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Gun the engine to back off the ice
options.why: Looks like the way to save the car, but the vibration cracks the ice faster.

options.text: Grab your bag and walk carefully to shore
options.why: Faster, but standing puts more weight on thin ice.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Tie a rope to a tree and try to pull the car back
options.why: Clever, but slow, and the ice keeps cracking.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

scenes.title: The Root Cellar
scenes.text: Your gamble led you off the highway to a farm off the highway. The family keeps a stone root cellar full of potatoes, apples, and canned food, and they're worried about raiders.

options.text: Offer to take them east with you
options.why: A big group, slower, but stronger.

options.text: Offer to stand guard tonight for a share of food
options.why: They need help. The player gets food and a safe night.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 10): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Lock them out of their own root cellar
options.why: They're desperate and armed.

options.text: Buy a sack of potatoes and keep going
options.why: Fine.

scenes.title: Antler in the Grille
scenes.text: Two scenarios after you crept through the elk herd, steam pours from your hood. An elk antler punctured the grille and radiator, and the engine is overheating.

options.text: Swap the radiator from an abandoned car
options.why: Doable, but it takes hours and tools.

options.text: Pour pepper from the snack bag into the radiator to plug the small hole, then top it off with melted snow
options.why: A real old-school roadside trick. Pepper grains plug small radiator leaks for a while.

options.text: Keep driving until the engine overheats completely
options.why: The engine seizes. No more car.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Stop every 20 miles to add melted snow
options.why: It works, but it's very slow.

scenes.title: A Message from the Sky
scenes.text: The crop-duster pilot you met flies low over your car, wagging his wings. A bottle with a note drops into the snow nearby: "Omaha bridge closes tomorrow. Cross TONIGHT."

options.text: Ignore it. Pilots don't know roads
options.why: The bridge closes, and the player loses a day.

options.text: Follow his advice and cross tonight
options.why: The player gets across before the closure.

options.text: Try to signal the pilot back for more info
options.why: He's already gone, and it wastes time.

options.text: Cross first thing in the morning
options.why: Close call. The player just makes it.

flags.gets: The sheriff signs a letter naming you a county volunteer.
flags.payoff: Show the sheriff's letter; emergency volunteers cross first

flags.gets: A refuge ranger gives you a satellite phone number for the East Coast evacuation office.
flags.payoff: Call the evacuation office on the ranger's satellite number

conds.text: Fill up from the fuel trucks outside the stadium
Tell the soldiers you were bitten and ask for their medic
Follow a snowplow convoy through the blizzard

cities.route: I-90 East: Snoqualmie Pass > Spokane > Montana > Wyoming > Black Hills > South Dakota > Wisconsin > Chicago > Indianapolis > Cincinnati
cities.profile_old: A mild, rainy start (41°F) means slower early spread. The player leaves a wet city and drives straight into the coldest country in the game: Montana and the Dakotas. Skipping winter gear on Day 2 hurts. Safe zone: Cincinnati's fortified riverfront.
cities.profile: A mild, rainy start (January normal 42.8°F, NOAA) means slower early spread. The player leaves a wet city and drives straight into the coldest country in the game: Montana and the Dakotas. Skipping winter gear on Day 2 hurts. Safe zone: Cincinnati's fortified riverfront.

scenes.title: Rain and Ferries
scenes.text: It's a gray, rainy morning in Seattle. Alarms sound downtown. The ferry terminal is packed with screaming people, and I-90 east toward the mountains is still moving.

options.text: Stock up at a grocery store first, then drive east
options.why: Food and water for days, but the lines are long and tense.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 36.5 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +15 health from rest

options.text: Drive east on I-90 toward the mountains right now
options.why: Leave before the roads clog. Mild weather makes the early escape easier.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Ride the monorail downtown to look for your friend
options.why: Loyal, but the player is now in the city center.

options.text: Crowd onto a ferry to the islands
options.why: Islands sound safe, but a packed ferry spreads infection, and there's no escape from the boat.

scenes.title: Snoqualmie Pass
scenes.text: The rain turns to heavy snow as you climb Snoqualmie Pass. Signs flash "Chains Required." A car spins out ahead of you and slams into the guardrail.
scenes.place: between Seattle, WA and Spokane, WA

options.text: Check on the car that crashed
options.why: The driver is hurt, and maybe more than hurt.

options.text: Sleep at the ski area lodge at the summit
options.why: Warm, with a snack bar, but crowded with travelers.

options.text: Ignore the signs and keep driving
options.why: The car slides off the steep grade.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Pull over and put chains on before going any higher
options.why: Required by law and life-saving on the pass.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: Spokane Gear Store
scenes.text: Spokane's streets are quiet. A big outdoor-gear store sits near the highway with its doors wide open. Montana is next, and you're dressed for Seattle rain.

options.text: Grab snacks and water only
options.why: Partial prep. The player will regret it in Montana. Sets NO_WINTER_GEAR.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Skip the gear, since you'll be in the car
options.why: If the car breaks down, rain jackets mean frostbite. Sets NO_WINTER_GEAR.

options.text: Check the hospital next door for medicine
options.why: Medicine is there, but so are the infected.

options.text: Get real winter gear: parka, boots and gloves
options.why: Montana and the Dakotas will be far colder. Gear up now.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower
now also sets WINTER_GEAR: You're wearing a real parka, boots and gloves.

scenes.title: The Toxic Lake
scenes.text: Near Butte, Montana, an old open-pit mine has filled with a red lake. Your water is almost gone. A mine office nearby has a light on.
scenes.place: between Spokane, WA and Billings, MT

options.text: Fill your water jugs from the lake
options.why: Water is water? No. It's toxic mine water that will poison the player.

options.text: Check the mine office, which has a generator and a water cooler
options.why: Warm, locked and safe, with clean drinking water.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 0, water 35): you can only carry so much
time 1.5 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Camp outside town and melt snow for water
options.why: Works, but slowly.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%

options.text: Search the old mine buildings for supplies
options.why: Unstable buildings and possibly bad air.
changes: risky grab now pays: +15 food, +10 water
time 1.5 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

scenes.title: The Continental Divide
scenes.text: Homestake Pass crosses the Continental Divide. It's -10°F. Your engine sputters. The fuel line is freezing, and the infected are walking up the road behind you.
scenes.weather_note: -10°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 27.0°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Coast the car downhill to restart it
options.why: Risky on an icy mountain grade.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Idle the engine to warm the fuel line
options.why: Works slowly, and burns fuel.

options.text: Keep driving and hope it clears
options.why: The engine dies on the pass.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Add fuel-line antifreeze from the gas station at the top
options.why: A real winter trick that keeps fuel flowing.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: Refinery Glow
scenes.text: In Billings, an oil refinery glows on the horizon. Armed workers guard the gates. The smell of food drifts from their camp kitchen.
scenes.place: between Billings, MT and Rapid City / Black Hills, SD

options.text: Skip it and use what you have
options.why: Okay for now, but the empty plains are ahead.

options.text: Ask to stay inside the refinery overnight
options.why: Safe walls, but they'll want the player to work a shift.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Offer to trade a skill (fixing, cooking, guarding) for food and fuel
options.why: They need help more than supplies. A full tank and a hot meal.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 15): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower
now also sets FUEL_VOUCHER: The refinery foreman gives you a fuel voucher for the Cincinnati depot.

options.text: Sneak through the fence to fill up
options.why: Guards with floodlights. Shots fired.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

scenes.title: The Tower
scenes.text: Devils Tower, a giant rock column, rises from the snowy plains. A group of stranded rock climbers is camped at its base, and infected are circling their camp.

options.text: Climb the tower for a lookout point
options.why: Looks like a smart scouting move, but it's icy rock and the player has no training.

options.text: Wave and keep driving
options.why: Safe, but no gear.

options.text: Help the climbers scare off the infected, then trade for rope and hand warmers
options.why: Climbers carry exactly the gear needed for cold, dark survival. Sets CLIMBING_ROPE.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Invite the climbers to join you
options.why: Good allies, but more mouths to feed.

scenes.title: Free Ice Water
scenes.text: In Wall, South Dakota, a roadside store famous for its "Free Ice Water" signs is lit by lanterns. A family has taken it over. It's -18°F tonight.
scenes.place: between Rapid City / Black Hills, SD and La Crosse, WI
scenes.weather_note: -18°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 21.6°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Sleep alone in a Badlands canyon
options.why: Out of the wind, but -18°F with no fire.
changes: time 1 h -> 0.5 h: the fast option

options.text: Ask politely and offer to help guard the store
options.why: They keep the tradition alive: free water, food and a warm floor to sleep on.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 35): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Try to take supplies while they're busy
options.why: They have hunting rifles, and they've been watching since the first billboard.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Fill water at the gas station next door
options.why: Some water, but a cold night.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

conditional.text: Siphon the store's delivery truck with the family's permission
conditional.why: Asking first turns a theft into a trade.

scenes.title: -25°F in Minnesota
scenes.text: Southern Minnesota is -25°F, the coldest morning in 30 years. Your windshield is cracking from the cold, and you can barely feel your toes.
scenes.weather_note: -25°F is a fictional record storm; the real January normal here is 18.9°F (NOAA 1991-2020).

options.text: Blast the heater on the cracked windshield
options.why: Sudden heat on cold glass makes the crack spread.

options.text: Pour hot water on the windshield to clear it
options.why: Looks smart, but the glass shatters from the temperature shock.

options.text: Duct-tape the crack and drive slowly
options.why: It works, and the crack stops spreading.

options.text: Stay in shelter until the afternoon warms up
options.why: At -25°F, exposed skin freezes in minutes. Wait for the warmest part of the day.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

unlocked.text: Bundle up and scrape the windshield from outside
unlocked.why: With real gear, ten minutes outside at -25°F is safe, and the glass stays whole.

scenes.title: The Water Park Town
scenes.text: Wisconsin Dells is full of giant indoor water parks. One is still heated, and survivors are living inside with a full snack bar.
scenes.place: between La Crosse, WI and Indianapolis, IN

options.text: Go for a swim in the warm water
options.why: Feels great, but the player has to go back out wet into 0°F.

options.text: Trade for food and leave
options.why: Fine.

options.text: Join them for food and a warm place to rest
options.why: Warm, organized and well supplied.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 30, water 30): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Stay a full day
options.why: Comfortable, but time lost.

conditional.text: Skip the water park and drive straight through Wisconsin tonight
conditional.effects_text: saves 5 h; night driving at sub-zero
conditional.why: You gain half a day if nothing goes wrong.

scenes.title: Chicago Burning
scenes.text: Chicago's skyline is covered in smoke. The radio says I-94 is jammed and the I-294 bypass is open. A crowd of infected is spilling onto the highway ahead.

options.text: Drive through downtown on I-94
options.why: Jammed and full of infected.
changes: tagged TRAP: a tempting shortcut that plays out badly

options.text: Take the I-294 bypass west of the city
options.why: Avoid a city of 2.7 million.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Wait for the smoke to clear
options.why: Time lost while the jams build.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 9 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%, +5 health from rest

options.text: Take Lake Shore Drive along the lake
options.why: Pretty, but packed with fleeing cars.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

scenes.title: The Dome
scenes.text: Indianapolis is dark. A stadium with a giant dome has military trucks parked outside. Soldiers are handing out ration packs at the gate.
scenes.place: between Indianapolis, IN and Ohio River crossing (CVG), KY/OH

options.text: Camp outside the city
options.why: Fine, but no rations.

options.text: Drive on through the night
options.why: Night roads.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Go into the stadium to sleep
options.why: Looks safe with the military there, but crowds spread infection.

options.text: Take the rations and ask the soldiers about Cincinnati
options.why: They confirm the safe zone is open and share food and water.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 25): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

conditional.text: Ask the soldiers' medic to treat a bite
conditional.why: The Guard has medicine, and you're still before onset.

scenes.title: The Ohio River
scenes.text: The Ohio River separates you from Cincinnati. An old suspension bridge and a jammed highway bridge both cross it. Infected are wandering on the riverbank.

options.text: Swim the river
options.why: Freezing water. Hypothermia in minutes.
changes: tagged TRAP: sounds appealing, plays out badly

options.text: Drive the jammed highway bridge
options.why: Fine, but it takes hours to reach the gate.
changes: slow but safest: keeps its 3.5 h story delay, injury chance 15% -> 5%

options.text: Find a boat to cross
options.why: Strong currents and floating ice.
changes: saves 2 h of driving: the fast option

options.text: Cross the old suspension bridge on foot with your gear
options.why: It's the closest crossing to the safe zone, and soldiers guard it.
changes: time 0.5 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

scenes.title: The Bandaged Hand
scenes.text: At the Cincinnati riverfront gate, a guard points at your companion's bandaged hand. "Unwrap it. Now." Your companion looks at you, panicked.
scenes.gate_check: Every final gate now runs a screening check before admission. Not infected: admitted. Infected but not turned: quarantine with treatment (90%, fictional). The clock still matters: if a time penalty pushes arrival past Day 7 midnight, the ending is TOO LATE. No single choice at the gate ends the game by itself anymore.

options.text: Calmly unwrap it together and explain how it happened
options.effects_text: 1 h; both screened
options.why: Honesty and calm keep things from escalating.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Offer the guard your supplies to skip the check
options.effects_text: -15 food; checked anyway
options.why: The guard takes the food and checks the hand anyway.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Let the guard handle it and step back
options.effects_text: you enter; your companion goes to quarantine
options.why: Safe for you, hard on your companion.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

options.text: Grab your companion and run for another entrance
options.effects_text: chased: -20 health; other gate 4 h later
options.why: You still get in, just hurt and late.
changes: rewritten final-gate option

unlocked.text: Show the guards the foreman's fuel voucher
unlocked.effects_text: 0.5 h; both of you screened kindly
unlocked.why: You arrive with a fuel contact the city needs. The guards are calmer and the check is gentle.

scenes.title: Stuck on the Logging Road
scenes.text: Your bad choice put your car stuck in deep snow on a forest logging road in the mountains at dusk. Shapes are moving between the trees.

options.text: Run into the woods
options.why: Looks like escape, but the player gets lost in the dark forest.

options.text: Build a fire to scare them away
options.why: Fire draws more than it scares away.

options.text: Lock the car doors and stay quiet
options.why: It works, but it's a long, tense night.

options.text: Climb onto a stacked log truck nearby and wait
options.why: High and hard to climb. The infected can't reach the player, and they wander off by morning.

scenes.title: The Hutterite Colony
scenes.text: Your gamble took you off I-90 to a Hutterite farming colony in Montana. These communal farms are self-sufficient, and the colony is calm, with a big kitchen and barns.

options.text: Buy bread and eggs and leave
options.why: Fine.

options.text: Ask to stay several days
options.why: Kind, but the player loses days.

options.text: Respectfully ask for shelter and offer to help with chores
options.why: They welcome respectful visitors. Warm meals and news.
changes: supplies capped at 20 each (was food 25, water 20): you can only carry so much
time 1 h -> 2 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Barge in demanding food
options.why: They close their gates on the player.

scenes.title: Engine Fire
scenes.text: Your bad choice pushed your old engine too hard on the South Dakota plains. Smoke pours from under the hood and you see flames.

options.text: Pull over, get everyone out, and throw snow on it from the side without opening the hood all the way
options.why: Opening the hood all the way feeds the fire air. Snow works on small engine fires.
changes: time 1 h -> 1.5 h: the careful way is slower

options.text: Grab your bags and move far away from the car
options.why: Safe, but the car is lost.
changes: time 1.5 h -> 1 h: quicker than the careful option, safer than the fast one

options.text: Keep driving to the next town
options.why: Fire can spread to the fuel tank.

options.text: Throw the hood fully open to see the fire

scenes.title: The Famous Clinic

scenes.title: White Fingertips
scenes.text: You skipped warm gear in Spokane. Now, in the Montana cold, your fingertips are white, numb, and waxy-looking.

options.text: Rewarm your hands in your armpits or in warm (not hot) water
options.why: This is frostnip. Gentle warmth is the right fix.

options.text: Rub your hands with snow
options.why: An old myth that makes frostbite worse.

options.text: Wear socks on your hands and keep going
options.why: Helps a little.

options.text: Hold them near the car heater vents
options.why: Numb skin can't feel heat, so it's easy to burn.

scenes.title: The Grid Goes Down
scenes.text: A surprise ice storm hits Austin and the power grid fails. People are fighting at gas stations, and the news reports attacks downtown. Your water taps are sputtering.

options.why: Loyal, but downtown is where the attacks started.
